newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Main owners of Orrefors say in ownership talks.
newsitem.headline: Main owners of Orrefors say in ownership talks.

text.p: The main owners of luxury goods company Orrefors Kosta Boda AB said on Friday they were in discussions over the long-term ownership of the company.
The owners are Swedish investment company Investor AB, Proventus AB and Royal Copenhagen AS.
"These discussions are expected to be completed by October 28," the three companies said in a joint statement.
The statement said further information will be provided before trading opens on the Stockholm stock exchange on October 29.
On the announcement, trading in Orrefors Kosta Boda was suspended on the Stockholm bourse at the request of the company.
The share was last traded at 140 crowns.
The ownership of Orrefors Kosta Boda has been in a state of flux for some weeks.
Royal Copenhagen, which is 82 percent owned by Danish brewer Carlsberg AS, this month raised to 17.1 percent its holding in the upmarket Swedish glassmaker, saying this was a mark of good faith.
It said this was building on a sales alliance agreed between silver, porcelain and glass maker Royal Copenhagen and Orrefors Kosta Boda in July.
But the move prompted Proventus to seek to raise its own stake in Orrefors while warning that it suspected Royal Copenhagen of trying to bring the prestigious label under Danish control.

Trading in Orrefors was suspended briefly earlier this month after Proventus raised its stake in the upmarket glassmaker to 21.1 percent of capital and votes and bought an option that would allow it take a further 9.1 percent stake.
Proventus then bid 145 crowns a share to shareholders in Orrefors for shares corresponding to 20 percent of the capital in the company.
Unlisted Proventus is owned 91.5 percent by Swedish financier Robert Weil and 8.5 percent by managing director Mikael Kamras.
As of July 27 this year, the Swedish Wallenberg business empire owned 23.1 percent of share capital and votes of Orrefors through its investment company Investor.
